author: New China TV
description:
The Chinese and U.S. militaries on Tuesday held a ceremony in Chengdu, southwest China's Sichuan Province, where China handed over the remains of U.S. airmen who aided China's resistance against Japanese aggression during World War II (WWII), according to China's Ministry of National Defense.
The remains were recovered in areas along the Hump Route, a vital air corridor over the Himalayas that became a wartime lifeline for China. From 1942 to 1945, the route served as a key channel for Allied supplies to support China's resistance against Japanese aggression.
title: China hands over remains of U.S. airmen found along WWII Hump Route

author: New China TV
description:
The fifth plenary session of the 20th Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee concluded recently in Beijing, adopting a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.
In an interview with Xinhuanet, Josef Gregory Mahoney, professor of politics at East China Normal University, said the plenum is of great significance to advancing Chinese modernization and offers useful lessons for political parties worldwide in exploring effective governance.
"The signal is that the Party treats discipline as a condition of governing," Mahoney said, adding that this highlights the CPC's character and political wisdom.
title: Sustained commitment to self-governance demonstrates CPC's political wisdom: U.S. scholar
